set.body:
Objective

Independently certify that the abstraction lift is mathematically correct, resource-bounded, backward compatible, documented, and valid as an installed package.

Primary ownership

Cross-cutting law/oracle suites, benchmarks, public documentation and vignette, installed-package checks, and evidence recorded on this bead. Production fixes discovered here remain scoped to their owning child.

Certification gates

- Complete algebraic law suite and negative noncommutation guards pass.
- Existing self-geometry public suite passes without silent semantic changes.
- Rectangular complete/direct, centered, normalized, transformed, sparse-query, and bridged paths agree with independent oracles.
- Dense/sparse frames, feature blocking, memory/block storage, and supported execution paths agree under the numerical contract.
- Compiler preflight is demonstrated to fail before source reads.
- Measured memory remains within conservative plans for all four lowering classes.
- Scientific plan IDs and receipts change under every semantic change and ignore nonsemantic execution changes where promised.
- Documentation explains effect form versus geometry, stage ordering, capabilities, bridge requirements, and inference limits.
- An installed-package workflow runs both legacy self-geometry and unequal-axis bipartite examples.

Completion evidence

Record exact commands, package revision, platform, pass/fail/qualified status, and any unrun external gates. This bead blocks epic completion.
set.title: Certify effect-form compatibility, resources, documentation, and artifacts
